            private static global::System.Text.Json.Serialization.Metadata.JsonTypeInfo<T>? TryResolveTypeInfo<T>(global::Blueprint.HttpClient.BlueprintHttpClient client)
            {

                }
            }

            internal static BlueprintClientPlan For(global::Blueprint.HttpClient.BlueprintHttpClient client)
            {

            }
